source: docs/TEAM.md registered project (four-player cooperative, shared decisions, private clues); execution/SYS_15_ROLE_MODES.md; docs/GAMEPLAY_DESIGN_FINAL.md section 5 (Solo, Family/Class); game-design/10_GAMEPLAY_SYSTEMS.md 'Role facts and communication debrief'; full-game-story/STORY_FULL.md EX-CH01-S07 (role acknowledgement before the commit). Role facts themselves stay in p02_mission_table.json.

solo.label: SOLO
solo.summary: One player holds all four roles. Every crew note is on the Mission Table and in the journal.

class.label: CLASS
class.summary: Two to four players share this machine. Crew notes stay private: read yours one player at a time, discuss, then every role signs the team plan before the operator locks it in.

seat_plan_note: Mei and Rafi never share a seat: the shift 3-4 decision (when to fill the wall and when to return the water) only becomes clear when their two notes meet in discussion (10_GAMEPLAY_SYSTEMS.md, combined-evidence decision).

handoff.cover_line: Everyone else, look away. Nothing on the next screen is shown to the crew.
handoff.cover_hint: Using printed cards? Hand {name}'s card to {holder} instead and press HIDE.
handoff.reveal_button: I HOLD {NAME}'S ROLE · SHOW MY NOTE
handoff.read_footer: Tell the crew what matters in your own words. Keep the numbers you need. This screen is private.
handoff.none_arrived: No crew note has arrived yet. Notes arrive as the night plan unfolds.

table.cards_title_class: CREW NOTES · PRIVATE UNTIL EACH ROLE SHARES
table.share_requires_read: {name}'s note has not been read privately yet. Pass the screen or the printed card to {holder} first.
table.shared_hint: The crew heard it from {holder}; the numbers stay on the printed card or the private screen.

team_plan.title: TEAM PLAN · EVERY ROLE SIGNS
team_plan.instruction: Each role reads the plan and signs it. The operator locks it in only after all four signatures.
team_plan.incomplete: Set every choice and read the forecast before the crew signs.
team_plan.operator_blocked: Every role signs before the operator locks in ({signed} of {total}).
team_plan.solo_note: SOLO · you hold all four roles, so no sign-off round is needed.
team_plan.changed_notice: The plan changed; earlier signatures no longer apply.

menu.heading: WHO IS PLAYING?
menu.print_hint: Printable crew notes for classrooms: docs/classroom/role_cards (PDF and PNG).

settings.heading: CREW MODE
settings.note: Changeable any time. Class mode hides crew-note facts from the shared screen and asks every role to sign the team plan.

print.title: LAST LIGHT ACADEMY · CREW NOTES
print.subtitle: Seven Shifts, the night plan · Class mode · one card per role · private until you choose to share
how_to: Deal one card per role. With 2 or 3 players, use the seat plan below.
Read your card privately. Tell the crew what matters in your own words.
Discuss. Then each role signs the team plan on screen before the operator locks it in.
Cards arrive at different shifts: keep later cards face down until the screen says they have arrived.
print.footer: Training units, not real measurements. Aurora Station, the cadets and the 2046 dates are fictional. Independent team project · not NASA-endorsed.
